issue.title: SQL: Add BinaryMathProcessor to named writeables list

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
BinaryMathProcessor was missing from the list of register  named
writeables causing deserialization errors

Fix #30014
